text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good morning.
Fufu, it's a pleasant morning, isn't it~?
choice_data_list: Looks like you got plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks for giving me the day off.
It was a really great day.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I ate out the other day, and the zaru soba there was so delicious! Just thinking about it makes me want to go back again.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you should come with me next time!
There are some other places I want to check out, so...
How about we go on a restaurant tour together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Buena Vista
had a truly fulfilling day.
